14:   const keys = {};

20:   const powerUps = [];

22:   let lastPower = 0;
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let startTime = performance.now();
25:   let gameOver = false;
26:   // Audio context and helper
27:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
28:   function playSound(freq, dur) {
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.type = 'sine';
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
38:   }
39: 
40:   function spawnAsteroid() {
41:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 15;
42:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
43:     playSound(120, 0.08); // asteroid spawn beep
44:   }
45: 
46:   function spawnPower() {
47:     const size = 12;
48:     powerUps.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function update(dt) {
52:     // Move ship
53:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
57:     // keep inside bounds
58:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
59:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.size, ship.y));
60: 
61:     // Spawn asteroids every 800ms
62:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroid > 800) { spawnAsteroid(); lastAsteroid = performance.now(); }
63:     // Spawn power‑up every 8000ms
64:     if (performance.now() - lastPower > 8000) { spawnPower(); lastPower = performance.now(); }
65: 
66:     // Update asteroids
67:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const a = asteroids[i];
69:       a.y += a.speed;
70:       if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
71:     }
72:     // Update power‑ups
73:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const p = powerUps[i];
75:       p.y += p.speed;
76:       if (p.y > height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
77:     }
78: 
79:     // Collision detection
80:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
81:       const a = asteroids[i];
82:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) {
83:         if (ship.shield > 0) {
84:           // destroy asteroid, consume shield
85:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
86:           ship.shield--;
87:         } else {
88:           playSound(200, 0.3); // collision beep
89:           gameOver = true;

92:       }
93:     }
94:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const p = powerUps[i];

101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Score based on survival time
105:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
106:   }
107: 
108:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
109:     return a.x < b.x + b.size && a.x + a.size > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.size && a.y + a.size > b.y;
110:   }

112:   function draw() {
113:     // background: dark space with tiny stars

124:     ctx.closePath();
125:     ctx.fill();
126:

128:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
129:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(

132:       );
133:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777777');
134:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
135:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     });
140: 
141:     // power‑ups as rotating stars
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
143:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
144:       const cx = p.x + p.size / 2;
145:       const cy = p.y + p.size / 2;
146:       const spikes = 5;
147:       const outer = p.size / 2;
148:       const inner = outer / 2.5;
149:       ctx.save();
150:       ctx.translate(cx, cy);
151:       ctx.rotate(performance.now() / 500);
152:       ctx.beginPath();

154:         const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outer : inner;
155:         const angle = (i * Math.PI) / spikes;
156:         ctx.lineTo(r * Math.cos(angle), r * Math.sin(angle));
157:       }
158:       ctx.closePath();
